summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on the technical challenge of mapping unstructured location data (addresses/frames) to specific facility IDs. Initial difficulties included inconsistent identifiers and discrepancies between coordinates and listed addresses.

Later, a decision was made regarding how to integrate imported data: instead of attaching the newly imported data blocks to facilities created by someone else, it is better practice to add the additional data directly to the existing facilities that were already established.
decisions: Imported location data should be attached as supplementary information to existing facility records.
action_items: Integrate imported location data into existing facility records following the agreed-upon method.
